finding: Possible mixed spellings: base resolved only for check_target, so Verdict.folder differs from reason text and from target_for
why: With a linked root, check_target returns folder=realpath(base) while R-02/R-03/R-05/R-06 reasons (built from root.path) and every target_for verdict keep the unresolved spelling, so one refused verdict can show two spellings and the two entry points disagree on folder.
fix: Resolve base once for both name branches (or resolve root.path at the source) so folder and reason text share one spelling; assert it on a refused verdict in the new test.
evidence:
elif base is not None:
        base = os.path.realpath(base)
